meta.baseline: January 1995 (game turn 0) roster/title state, with later availability windows checked through 2001.

confidence_scale.High: Confirmed against multiple independent sources or a definitive contemporary record (results listings, title lineages, Wikipedia career chronology).
confidence_scale.Medium: Well-supported but from a single source, or a judgment call on a well-documented fact.
confidence_scale.Low: Inference from career chronology; flagged for manual verification.

meta.method: Every WRESTLERS entry (311), FA_ARRIVALS entry (23), TEAMS entry (28), INITIAL_TITLES entry (37), manager (16 incl. SEED_MANAGERS) and announcer assignment was checked against the January 1995 record (identity, company, age, alignment, title status, contract expiry vs. real departure dates) using the Wrestling-History research corpus (91 quarterly research files), contemporary results archives (thehistoryofwwe.com, theofficialwrestlingmuseum.com), title-lineage databases (wrestling-titles.com, prowrestling.fandom.com, luchawiki.org) and Wikipedia. The 291-event TIMELINE was audited on its dated milestones (PPV dates, talent moves, angle starts). Ratings (pop/work/mic/ceiling) were spot-checked against 1995-96 star levels rather than individually re-derived; no change is proposed for a rating without a stated reason.
meta.sources_note: Per-finding sources are embedded in each finding. "Research:" refers to the quarterly research files in the Wrestling-History repository (e.g. WCW_Jan-Mar_1995_Research.md). "Web:" URLs were retrieved 2026-08-29.
meta.v2_scope: Adds to v1: INITIAL_FACTIONS audit, engine.js generated-worker assumptions (950 unsigned indies + 37 local jobbers), the full worker-classification of the 1,298-worker fresh-game world, ratings/ceiling/age stat audit, injury/death/retirement coverage, a complete turn 0-599 calendar conversion, and structured patch recommendations. Sources for v1 findings are preserved in v1 (commit 258d3ee); v2 additions carry their own sources.

meta.turn_calendar_note: 48 turns/year, 4/month. Full per-turn table (turns 0-599) is in the turn_calendar key of the JSON. The game timeline extends to turn 599 (June 2007); the historical audit window is 1995-2001.
meta.v2_turn_corrections: v2 recomputed EVERY turn reference from the engine dateInfo formula (year=1995+turn//48, month=(turn//4)%12, week=(turn%4)+1) and corrected the v1 recommendations whose turn numbers were mis-derived (e.g. Hogan heel turn 79->72, Goldberg 136->131, Hennig 137->129, Warrior 185->174, Piper 94->87, Cole 106-110->119, Tazz 241->243, Lita 253->245, Jacqueline 178->164, Val Venis 174->163, DX 118-120->129-131, Pillman contract 50->53, Mark Henry 16->57, Bigelow contract 46->43, Austin neck injury 137-143->124-137, deaths: Pillman 139->132, Yokozuna 277->279, Baba 201->195, Jumbo 262->257, Rude 212->206, Spicolli 156->150, Angle 231->233). Game-side current turns are unchanged; all corrected values are stated with their real-world dates in the findings.

summary.headline: Of 1,298 fresh-game workers: 311 are real seeded performers (237 verified clean, 74 with findings), 23 are scripted future arrivals (15 mis-dated), 987 are fictional generated talent, plus 31 announcer slots. 12 championship holders are wrong at the start; 7 duplicate people exist; and 15 tier-1 historical workers (Kurt Angle, Edge, Christian, the Hardys, the Dudleys, Mark Henry, Rick Rude, Megumi Kudo, ...) are missing from the game entirely, on top of the 9 already flagged in v1.
